senses.gloss: f. pl. (קזז), only in ק׳ אדמה cut pieces, clods of earth.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:1">Maas. Sh. V, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 69a:4">B. Kam. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>קְזוֹזוֹת</he> (Ms. F. <cite ref="S00271"><he>קוּזּוֹת</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:1">Gen. R. s. 42</cite>, beg. <he>היה אוכל ק׳ א׳ וכ׳</he> he (R. El. b. Horḳ’nos) ate (sucked) lumps of earth; Yaik.
